title: Property of affine finite-presentation descent
statement:
The algebra $B_{\lambda_B}$ is finitely presented over
$A_{\lambda_B}$, and the constructed map $\beta_B$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use the stagePresentation field of def-nagata-affine-fp-descent. The relation ideal is generated by the range of relationMap, a finite family indexed by Fin m. Mathlib Submodule.fg_span and Set.finite_range show it is finitely generated, and Algebra.FinitePresentation.iff applied to stagePresentation.symm gives finite presentation of stageAlgebra.

source.place: Proof, finite presentation by the displayed quotient

proof.text: The tensorPresentation and presentation fields of def-nagata-affine-fp-descent identify the tensor product and the colimit algebra with the same quotient. Compose tensorPresentation with presentation.symm. This algebra equivalence has underlying algebra homomorphism beta by the beta_eq field (definitionally, the underlying homomorphism of the composite is the composite of the underlying homomorphisms). This supplies the required inverse without any further coefficientwise calculation, since that identification is retained in the descent datum.

source.place: Proof, base-changed presentation and mutually inverse comparison maps

proof_origin.place: Proof, implemented from the retained quotient presentations using Mathlib.Algebra.FinitePresentation.iff

blueprint_update.statement:
The algebra $B_{\lambda_B}$ is finitely presented over
$A_{\lambda_B}$, and the constructed map $\beta_B$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text:
The displayed quotient is a finite presentation by construction. Tensoring
it with $A$ sends every lifted relation to the original $r_j$ and preserves
the finite polynomial presentation. Thus the base-changed presentation is
the chosen presentation of $B$, with $\beta_B$ and its generatorwise inverse
mutually inverse.
